prompt: Choose the grammatically INCORRECT sentence.
options: I go to school every morning!
I goes to school every morning.
I go to school every morning.
correction: I go to school every morning.
explain: Câu sai là “I goes to school every morning.”. Sửa: “I go to school every morning.”. I + go diễn tả thói quen hiện tại.

prompt: Choose the incorrect word or phrase in the sentence.
markedSentence: There [[is]] two bags on the desk.
explain: “is” dùng sai trong câu. Cần sửa thành “are”. Câu đúng: There are two bags on the desk. Two bags là số nhiều nên dùng are.
